title: Self-service support and escalation
bodyMarkdown:
## Find an answer or prepare a safe support request

1. Search for the visible control name, intended action, SDK/CLI/MCP name or error category. Read prerequisites and capability status before following the procedure. Current draft coverage is incomplete; a missing result is not evidence that an undocumented remote API exists.
2. Identify the exact supported version/platform/provider/client from qualification and release notes. Note whether the issue is native operation, a synthetic preview or a planned hosted capability.
3. Reduce the problem to a fabricated fixture. Record expected versus actual behavior, version, OS/architecture, safe error category and non-sensitive operation/correlation ID where available.
4. Use public Discussions for usage/design questions and Issues for reproducible synthetic bugs/features. Report vulnerabilities through the private security advisory route. Follow SUPPORT.md and SECURITY.md for the approved channel.
5. Keep actual secrets, operational ciphertext, tokens, recovery material, private endpoints, environment dumps and raw MCP output out of the request. For lifecycle failures state the stage (directory, exposure evidence, exception, issuer mutation or consumer activation) without alert bodies or replacement credentials.

## Synthetic support-ticket journey

In Account Support, inspect the collection, open the allowed create dialog, supply synthetic text, review and complete the mock action only in the local preview. Inspect its status/details and reload to confirm local persistence; a read-only presentation may hide Create/Edit. This is not a message transmission or connected helpdesk. No automatic diagnostic attachment is needed.

Real customer support history must authorize the exact account/tenant and safe fields through a qualified approved private service. No installed package or mock ticket creates paid support, SLA or SSO entitlement. Private billing/key details do not belong in public GitHub support. A support request does not authorize account enrollment, purchase, revocation or incident dismissal.

## Local help behavior

Search and ranking stay in the browser. Only approved public documentation/index/article chunks may be loaded progressively. Queries, policies and user values must not be uploaded or inserted into remote URLs. An unavailable article/search error should be recoverable without discarding the active editor draft.
capabilityStatus: Public channels accept synthetic questions and bug reports; vulnerabilities use the private security route. Preview tickets stay local and are not sent to a helpdesk. Support terms require a separate agreement.
